content: साधक {%a.%} [साध्-ण्वुल्, सिध्-णिच् ण्वुल् साधादेशः वा <ls>Tv.</ls>] (-धका|-धिका|{%f.%}) .²1 Accomplishing, fulfilling, effecting, completing. .²2 Efficient, effective; त्वं सर्वतोगामि च साधकं च <ls>Ku. 3. 12</ls>. .²3 Skilful, adept. .²4 Effecting by magic, magical. .²5 Assisting, helping. .²6 Conclusive. .{@-कः@} .²1 A magician. .²2 One possessed of supernatural powers, a yogin; अविचलितमनोभिः साधकैर्मृग्यमाणः <ls>Māl. 5. 1</ls>. .{@-का@} <ab>N.</ab> of Durgā.
